name: opencode-v2-agent-orchestrator
description: A V2-only multi-agent orchestration plugin for OpenCode.

scripts.build: bun run build:plugin && bun run build:tui && bun run build:commands && bun run build:installer && bun run build:cli && bun run build:types
scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external zod --external jsonc-parser
scripts.build:tui: bun build src/tui.ts --outfile dist/tui.js --target bun --format esm --external zod --external solid-js --external @opentui/solid --external @opentui/core
scripts.build:commands: bun build src/commands.ts --outfile dist/commands.js --target bun --format esm --external zod
scripts.build:installer: bun build src/installer.ts --outfile dist/installer.js --target bun --format esm --external jsonc-parser --external zod
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outfile dist/cli/index.js --target bun --format esm --external jsonc-parser --external zod
scripts.dev:v2:dist: bun run build && bun run src/cli/index.ts dev-run --dist
scripts.test:contract: for file in test/contract/*.test.ts; do bun test --max-concurrency=1 "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:package: bun run build && bun run scripts/package-smoke.ts
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:package
